title: Pinned projection formula isomorphism family
statement: For the data of lem-sc-right-adjoint-tensor-comparison-natural (with its hRf hypothesis), there exists a family of projection formula isomorphisms whose inverses are the specified pullback-adjunction mates.

proof.text: For perfect K use its monoidal dual. The adjunction projection mate is the conjugate of the invertible pullback tensorator at the dual. This proves the specified mate invertible on every perfect object.

Construct the global natural transformation τ whose component at K is the specified adjunction mate of inverse tensorator followed by counit. Prove naturality by the oplax tensorator, counit and homEquiv naturality. Choose separate exact shift structures for its source and target functors; no equality with the shift of τ is required.

Both functors preserve u-sized coproducts. The inclusion preserves ambient quasi-coherent coproducts; pullback is a left adjoint; tensorRight preserves coproducts; direct image preserves them on the quasi-coherent pullback-tensor family, whose quasi-coherence follows from tensor closure.

Use Q(K)=∀n,IsIso(τ_(K[n])). Perfection is stable under shifts, so the perfect case gives Q on perfects. The proved shift-saturated localizing-closure lemma puts perfectLocalizingClosure inside Q. Perfect generation makes every K belong to Q. Shift-zero transport gives IsIso of the original specified mate. Set pf=(asIso mate).symm; its pinned inverse equation is reflexive.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0A9U, 08EU and 09IS: global natural comparison and perfect generation of its all-integer-shifts isomorphism locus, using the five-term cone argument and separate exact structures.

theorem exists_rightAdjointTensorComparison_projection
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z) :
    ∃ pf : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
          (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
        K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
      ∀ K, (pf K).inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)).inv ≫
            (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)
